reason: The text fragment (Exodus 1:15-22) describes Hebrew midwives who demonstrate fear of God (וַתִּירֶאן אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים) and deliberately disobey Pharaoh's command to kill Hebrew male infants, choosing instead to preserve life. Their actions show reverence and obedience toward Yahweh, not ingratitude. God blesses them for this fear and obedience (וַיֵּיטֶב אֱלֹהִים לַמְיַלְּדֹת). The passage demonstrates the opposite of the statement: the Hebrew midwives' faithful respect for divine authority.
